question.text: Under Regulation 22A (Alternative Dispute Resolution) effective July 3, 2023:

answer.text: All claims/disputes shall be submitted to dispute-resolution mechanisms including mediation, conciliation, and/or arbitration

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Reg 22A mandates ODR for disputes arising from PMS activities. **The Trap:** ODR is NOT voluntary; investor can escalate per SEBI procedure. **Cross-Exam Context:** Same ODR framework for all intermediaries (III-A, V-A). **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Display SMART ODR link on your website and include it in client communications.
